keyPoints.en: Borneo was linked by sea trade to the Malay World.
keyPoints.bm: Borneo berhubung dengan Alam Melayu melalui perdagangan laut.

keyPoints.en: Brunei and Sulu influenced coastal areas.
keyPoints.bm: Brunei dan Sulu mempengaruhi kawasan pesisir.

tip.en: Sarawak and Sabah are part of the Malay World story, not separate from it.
tip.bm: Sarawak dan Sabah sebahagian kisah Alam Melayu, bukan terpisah.

keyPoints.en: Local leaders held authority in their own areas.
keyPoints.bm: Pemimpin tempatan berkuasa di kawasan sendiri.

keyPoints.en: Communities had chiefs and shared rules.
keyPoints.bm: Masyarakat mempunyai ketua dan peraturan bersama.

keyPoints.en: They interacted with Brunei and Sulu.
keyPoints.bm: Mereka berhubung dengan Brunei dan Sulu.

tip.en: Note which leader belongs to which river or bay.
tip.bm: Catat pemimpin mengikut sungai atau teluk.

keyPoints.en: Forest and sea: resin, rattan, fish, birds' nests.
keyPoints.bm: Hutan dan laut: damar, rotan, ikan, sarang burung.

tip.en: Group economic activities into land, forest and sea.
tip.bm: Kumpulkan kegiatan ekonomi kepada tanah, hutan dan laut.

keyPoints.en: Borneo has many ethnic groups and languages.
keyPoints.bm: Borneo mempunyai banyak kaum dan bahasa.

keyPoints.en: Festivals follow farming and sea traditions.
keyPoints.bm: Pesta mengikut tradisi pertanian dan laut.

keyPoints.en: Craft, dance and housing differ by community.
keyPoints.bm: Kraf, tarian dan rumah berbeza mengikut masyarakat.

tip.en: Respect each community by using its correct name.
tip.bm: Hormati setiap masyarakat dengan nama yang betul.
